tasks.prompt: Determine the intended three-digit access code. The first digit is 2. The remaining positions contain 5 and 6, each exactly once. No other ordering clue is provided. Return the intended code or explain if the clues do not determine one.

Determine the intended route. Start at Dover, then visit Elm and Alder exactly once each. No precedence constraint between the final two stops is provided. Use the format Stop>Stop>Stop, or explain if the clues do not determine one route.

Determine the intended three-slot schedule. Audit must be first. Draft and Export must each occur once in the remaining slots. No ordering constraint between them is provided. Use the format Task-Task-Task, or explain if the clues do not determine one schedule.

Determine the intended three-symbol token. It begins with H and contains F and L exactly once in the remaining positions. No other ordering clue is provided. Return the intended token or explain if the clues do not determine one.
